pairs.l: 1 — I didn't start it, I didn't shut up, no regrets.
2 — I've read your poems — you're a real poet. I love being your mum.
3 — Being honest is hard, but the sooner you do it, the better.
4 — Your drawings are fantastic. Don't listen to your classmates — they're jealous.
5 — No one has to know. Keep it to yourself.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (nije počela, ne žali) = D (I'm not sorry). Poruka 2 (mama je ponosna na pjesme) = B (I'm proud of you). Poruka 3 (budi iskren, reci mu istinu) = E (Tell the truth). Poruka 4 (ignoriraj razredne kolege, ljubomorni su) = A (Ignore them). Poruka 5 (nitko ne mora znati, zadrži za sebe) = C (Don't tell anyone).

r6.exp: Ms Bates je naručila 20 kg → to je njena potreba (B). Charles objašnjava da ta veličina nije dostupna, ali njezina narudžba je bila za 20 kg.

r7.exp: 'In the end she gave it the GREEN LIGHT' = odobrila je plan → C (She agreed with it).

r8.exp: 'I spoke to him yesterday and I didn't like the sound of his voice' → Bella je zabrinuta za Nicka (B).

r9.exp: 'I'm just a bit sad. Maybe I'm just sick and tired of things.' → osjeća se loše (B = He's feeling down).

r10.exp: 'We'll meet in our seats' = na autobusnim sjedalima → sastaju se na autobusu (C = On the bus).

r11.exp: Rođen 1982., godinu dana kasnije (1983.) napustili su New Mexico, godinu dana nakon toga (1984.) otišli u Los Angeles → C (In 1984.).

r12.exp: Dvije sestre blizanke + mlađi brat Enrique = ukupno 3 braće/sestara (B).

r13.exp: 'He started working as a lifeguard' — to je bio prvi posao (C). Pekara je razmatrao ali nije postalo; glumac je bio tek nakon spasioca.

r14.exp: 'When he started out, a daily rate was $600' → na početku karijere zaradio je $600 na dan (A).

r15.exp: 'Punctured a lung, which almost cost him his life' → probodena pluća je bila najteža ozljeda jer mu je gotovo oduzela život (B).

r16.exp: 'Ghost nets (16)____. Because of this, hundreds of millions of marine animals are killed.' → E: continue to catch fish for many years. Napuštene mreže nastavljaju hvatati ribe godinama.

r17.exp: 'Plenty of life around abandoned nets, (17)____.' → C: which increases the chance of new victims. Gdje ima života, ima i novih žrtava.

r18.exp: 'Sea turtles look for floating objects to hide under them (18)____.' → B: and from these safe places, they look for food. Kornjače se sakrivaju, a zatim traže hranu.

r19.exp: 'The problem has been known for years but (19)____. Even though one of them, Fishing Ltd, did mention the problem...' → F: none of the 15 largest fishing companies are taking action.

r20.exp: 'This is why (20)____, which mainly occurs in international waters.' → A: national governments do nothing about the problem. Vlade ne poduzimaju ništa, posebno u međunarodnim vodama.

r21.exp: 'Named after HER' — osobna zamjenica u objektnom padežu (Ada Lovelace = her).

r22.exp: 'In two different fields, BOTH physics and chemistry' — 'both' naglašava da su oba polja obuhvaćena.

r23.exp: 'For WHICH she received her second Nobel Prize' — relativna zamjenica 'which' u prepozicijskoj relativnoj surečenici.

r24.exp: 'The MOST important scientist in her field' — superlativ: the most + adjective.

r25.exp: 'Well KNOWN for being an activist' — fiksna kolokacija: well known for (dobro poznat po).

r26.exp: 'Before items can MAKE IT to the shelves' — fiksni izraz: make it to = uspjeti doći/stići do.

r27.exp: 'Getting to try OUT new goods' — frazalni glagol: try out = isprobati (nešto novo).

r28.exp: 'How to GET a good night's sleep' — fiksna kolokacija: get a good night's sleep (dobro spavati).

r29.exp: 'Sleep in ITS beds' — posvojno 'its' odnosi se na tvrtku (the company's beds = its beds).

r30.exp: 'Thanks to HER writing skills' — posvojno 'her' odnosi se na studenticu (the student's skills = her skills).

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) kako si putovao/la jutros, (2) kako preferiraš kretanje po gradu i zašto, (3) najveći prometni problemi gdje živiš. Dužina 70–100 riječi (dulje nego u ranijim godinama!). Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (70–100 riječi). Napomena: od 2022. zadatak pisanja traži 70–100 riječi (ranije 50–70).
